$comment: Copy to .env.json (git-ignored, never commit it). One entry per theme folder in themes/. Only LOCAL development sites: bond refuses network paths, folders that are not a DNN site, and skin/container folders it did not deploy itself (unless --adopt). Write Windows paths with forward slashes (C:/DNN/site): a single backslash is invalid JSON.

bond.$comment: siteRoot = the DNN site root (web.config, bin/, Portals/), used by bond deploy and passed to the e2e tests. prune: true = on each deploy, delete every file in the skin/container folder that the build does not have (files added by hand too). e2e = real-site tests (pnpm test:e2e); shell BOND_E2E_* variables win. Never production.
